verdict.rationale: Termius clearly supports opening multiple SSH sessions each tied to a distinct Host with its own settings (jump host, keychain credentials) and automatically logs a separate history per host, and community reports confirm real-world multi-host/multi-session workflows (monitoring via snippets, broadcasting commands). However, evidence never explicitly addresses per-session appearance (themes/fonts) customization, only implying it via generic 'context' features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or corroboration of per-session appearance/theme customization, and independent verification of session isolation at scale.
